review_scope_note: Stage-0 counts are project clinical review of source facts, not independent blinded ACMG adjudication (reserved for Stage-1). A count of 0 marks a visibility where the positive fact is absent and is recorded as a review note, not a hash-verifiable span.

sources.canonical_source: 赵培伟 等. Rett综合征的临床特点及MECP2基因突变分析. 中国当代儿科杂志 2014;16(4):393-396.

spans.quote: Heterozygous mutations were identified in 5 out of 9 patients
No mutations were detected in their parents

abstract.notes: English abstract names 5 mutations (c.913insT, c.316C>T, c.502C>T, c.808C>T, c.1126C>T) and states parents were not mutated.

spans.quote: 所有患儿父母均未检测到突变

fulltext.notes: Chinese results repeat the same 5 mutations and parental negativity; no increment over the abstract.

sources.canonical_source: 刘等. RTT样表型5例患儿的临床特点及基因变异分析. 中国优生与遗传杂志 2023.

abstract.notes: English abstract (source.md:21) states only that 4 cases were diagnosed as RTT and genetic analysis of children and parents was performed; it names no target variants and gives no per-case parental negativity.

spans.quote: 患儿父母均未检测到突变

fulltext.notes: Chinese full text gives parent WES with parental negativity (line 51) and a four-case variant table (line 55). The four cases are one family/series cluster, not four independent observations.

sources.canonical_source: 钟少君 等. MECP2基因变异所致Rett综合征1例临床及遗传学分析. 中国医药导报 2024.

abstract.notes: English abstract (source.md:21) reports a new heterozygous MECP2 missense variant c.710C>G (p.Pro237Arg) but does not state that both parents were tested and negative for the target locus.

fulltext.notes: Chinese full text gives proband/parent WES, Sanger confirmation, de novo status, and parental negativity at the target locus.
